Knowledge Centre

Make informed property decisions.

Practical guides for buying, renting, developing and appointing professionals in Kenya.

All guides

Land records

What a land search can—and cannot—tell you

Ask an independent advocate to identify the parcel, relevant registry and current official search route. Ardhisasa supports some land services; coverage and the correct process must be confirmed for the property.

Estate agents

Choose the person as carefully as the property

Obtain the agent’s full practising name, business details and registration information. Ask EARB about current registration and practising requirements, and confirm the identity matches the person you are engaging.

Developers

Separate the company, the land and the project

Identify the contracting legal entity and use the relevant BRS service to investigate its records. Ask who owns the land and whether that entity has the authority to develop and sell.

Off-plan purchases

Understand what happens if delivery changes

Have your own advocate review the proposed agreement before paying a reservation fee. Establish what is being sold, the land interest, specifications, price, taxes, fees and completion conditions.

Fraud awareness

Pause when the story or payment details change

Warning signs include urgency, refusal of independent checks, inconsistent names, altered payment instructions and requests to keep a transaction secret. These are reasons to pause and investigate, not public findings of wrongdoing.

Independent professionals

Build a team with clear roles

An advocate can advise on the legal transaction; a land surveyor on parcel and boundary matters; a valuer on valuation; an architect, quantity surveyor or engineer on the relevant design, cost or engineering scope. Define the work you need before appointing someone.

Diaspora planning

Keep control of a property process from abroad

Choose your own advocate and independent site representative in Kenya. Agree how you will verify identities, receive reports and confirm instructions across time zones. Do not delegate every check to the person selling the property.

Companies

Investigate the company behind a property deal

Ask which legal entity will sign the contract and receive funds. Use the appropriate BRS service to check its records and compare the details with the agreement.

Renting

Before you pay a rental deposit

View the property and check that the landlord or agent has authority to let it. Ask for a written lease, deposit terms, an inventory and an official receipt.

Commercial property

Commercial premises, service charges and goodwill

Build an occupancy budget that includes rent, deposit, service charges, fit-out, utilities, taxes and any requested goodwill payment. Ask who receives each payment and what it buys.

Development

Check the approvals for a construction project

Ask the relevant county how to confirm its planning and building approvals for the site. Match approvals against the actual location, applicant and plans.

Buying property

Before you commit to a property purchase

Identify the seller and parcel, arrange a visit and ask an independent advocate about the appropriate official search and required consents.

04 / DIASPORA PROPERTY HUB

Far from home.
Closer to the right information.

Distance can make property decisions harder. Build an independent support team in Kenya and keep control of the process.

  1. 01

    Appoint independent expertise

    Choose your own advocate and relevant licensed professionals. Confirm their standing independently, rather than relying only on a seller’s referral.

  2. 02

    Confirm the property and authority

    Ask your advocate about official searches, site checks and approvals. If someone acts for you, discuss the scope and safeguards of any power of attorney.

  3. 03

    Plan payment and follow-up

    Understand the agreement, milestones, taxes and payment safeguards before sending funds. Agree independent progress reports and keep copies of receipts. Confirm changed payment details by calling a separately verified number.
